Name: Directional Roughness
Description: Adds smooth, band-limited fractal roughness along the chosen angle, scaled by local uphill slope.

Sections.Name: Direction
Sections.Label: Direction
Sections.Description: Angle sets a horizontal direction. The effect follows its positive alignment with the local uphill slope.

Params.Name: Angle
Params.Label: Angle
Params.Description: Sets the horizontal detail direction; strength is masked by uphill slope alignment.

Sections.Name: Detail
Sections.Label: Fine detail
Sections.Description: Adds layered Perlin noise. Each octave doubles frequency and halves amplitude; undersampled layers fade out.

Params.Name: Frequency
Params.Label: Detail frequency
Params.Description: Controls the fine feature size at 1K resolution. Higher values create smaller detail; frequency scales with resolution.

Params.Name: Octaves
Params.Label: Fine layers
Params.Description: Adds progressively finer detail layers. Layers too small for the map resolution are automatically faded out.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Label: Detail strength
Params.Description: Maximum amplitude as a fraction of terrain height range; displacement is capped at three times local relief measured at the 1K reference frequency, so detail strength stays consistent as resolution rises.
